name: uk.co.teas/shop
title: teas.co.uk
description: teas.co.uk, a UK tea shop, in four tools: Ask Lee, the shop as a mini site, basket, account.

tools.name: ask_lee
tools.description: Ask Lee is the teas.co.uk tea adviser, the same one as the chat on teas.co.uk. Use this when someone asks a tea question in plain English or wants to chat about tea: "a strong morning tea that takes milk", "something caffeine free for bedtime under 5p a cup", "is Yorkshire Tea stronger than PG Tips", "what is rooibos", "do you deliver to France". It reads negations, budgets and time of day and answers from the shop's own product facts. Pass conversation_id from the previous answer to carry on the same conversation. Returns the answer in words, how sure it is, the teas it used with live prices, Tea Wiki articles and follow up questions, in a chat card where the person can keep asking.

message.description: What the person said, in their own words.

conversation_id.description: From the previous Ask Lee answer, to carry on the same conversation. Leave out to start a new one.

language.description: Optional: the language the person writes in (en, fr, de, es, nl, it, pl, pt, tr, ja, zh-hant). Found from the message when left out. The answer comes in that language when Ask Lee can write all of it there (answer_language says which); otherwise it is English, so reply to the person in their language.

brief.description: Optional: interpreted_request.brief from the last answer with one condition taken out, to ask the same message again without it (price_limit, strength, with_milk, caffeine, kind, format, exclusions, allergy).

tools.name: teas
tools.description: teas.co.uk, a UK online tea shop, as a small website inside the chat. Pick a page: "home" (what is there, offers, news), "shop" (search and browse tea and hot chocolate with live prices: words in query, or category, brand, kind, caffeine, on_offer, max_price (pounds a pack), max_price_per_cup (pence), with_milk, strength, format, organic, fairtrade, vegan, sort and page_number), "tea" (one tea in full by id or name: pictures, taste, brewing timer, wiki, recipes, similar and cheaper teas), "compare" (two to four ids side by side), "wiki" (search the Tea Wiki with query, or open an article by id), "recipes" (search with query, or open one by id), "news" (list, or open a story by id), "under_the_hood" (live findings on how AI systems use the shop), "socials", "delivery" (delivery and returns; with items and country it prices a basket), "join" (what a teas.co.uk account adds) or "report" (send a product or site problem to the team: issue_type and details). Everything here only reads, except report. For advice in plain English use ask_lee; to buy use basket.

id.description: For tea: a product id, link, barcode or name. For wiki, recipes or news: the item id or link.

ids.description: For compare: two to four product ids.

query.description: Words to search for (shop, wiki, recipes).

brand.description: Shop: brand name; the brand is described at the top.

on_offer.description: Shop: only products on offer now.

max_price.description: Shop: highest pack price in pounds, for example 5 or 4.99.

max_price_per_cup.description: Shop: highest price per cup in pence, for example 5.

with_milk.description: Shop: true for teas that suit milk, false for teas best without.

format.description: Shop: tea bags or loose leaf.

page_number.description: Shop, recipes or news: page number from 1.

country.description: Delivery: two letter country code, for example GB, IE or FR.

details.description: Report: what looks wrong, in a sentence or two. No personal details.

suggested_correction.description: Report: what you believe is right, and where that comes from.

tools.name: basket
tools.description: The teas.co.uk basket, only when the person asks. action "add" adds items (ids from teas or ask_lee; quantities add to what is there); "view" shows it with the subtotal and a delivery estimate; "update" sets one product (id) to a new quantity, 0 removes it; "checkout" returns a secure teas.co.uk link where the person signs in, chooses delivery and pays (it works for 7 days); "subscribe" gives the subscriber price and a link to set up a repeat delivery of one product (id); "undo" puts the basket back as it was before the last add or update, when nothing has changed since. Pass a fresh request_key with add or update: a retry with the same key never adds twice. Nothing is bought or charged here and payment details are never seen. Leave basket_id out on hosts that identify the person; otherwise pass the basket_id the first basket answer returned.

id.description: For update or subscribe: the product id.

quantity.description: For update: the new quantity, 0 removes it.

basket_id.description: Only for hosts that do not identify the person: the basket_id from the first basket answer.

request_key.description: Optional, for add and update: a new key for each change (8 to 80 letters, digits, dot, dash, colon or underscore). Sending the same change again with the same key does not add twice.

tools.name: my_account
tools.description: A signed in customer's teas.co.uk account; the assistant asks the person to link their account the first time. section "profile", "orders" (recent), "order" (status and courier tracking, order_number), "invoice" (order_number), "rewards" (reward points), "subscriptions" (repeat deliveries) or "returns" (return requests). Three changes run only when the person clearly asks and has confirmed the details: action "reorder" (order_number, optional only_ids) puts an earlier order back in the basket; "pause_subscription", "resume_subscription" or "cancel_subscription" (subscription_id; cancel is final); "start_return" (order_number, reason, items, details) sends a return request for review. Reward points are spent only by the person on teas.co.uk.

action.description: A change, only when the person asked for it.

only_ids.description: Reorder: only these product ids from the order.

reason.description: Return: damaged, faulty, wrong_item, missing_item, change_of_mind (unused and unopened) or other.

details.description: Return: what happened, in the person's words.
